description: A usage limit of an Amazon Redshift Serverless workgroup, made with Redshift Serverless's CreateUsageLimit. It caps the compute or cross-Region data sharing the workgroup uses in a period, and says what happens when the workgroup reaches it.

ResourceArn.description: The ARN of the workgroup the limit is for.

UsageType.description: What the limit counts: serverless-compute, in RPU hours, or cross-region-datasharing, in terabytes.

Amount.description: The limit: RPU hours for serverless-compute, or terabytes for cross-region-datasharing.

Period.description: The period the amount applies to. AWS uses monthly when the template leaves it out. A weekly period begins on Sunday.

BreachAction.description: What Redshift Serverless does when the workgroup reaches the limit. AWS uses log when the template leaves it out.

UsageLimitId.description: The ID AWS gives the usage limit.

UsageLimitArn.description: The ARN of the usage limit.
